subcategory_text: Transparency policies, processes, and procedures for communicating data processing purposes, practices, and associated privacy risks are established and in place.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-22 (Personally Identifiable Information Quality Management); SI-18
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.34, A.5.36 (Compliance with policies and standards for information security)
GDPR Art. 12 (Transparent information), Art. 13-14 (Information to be provided to data subjects)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.OC-04 (transparent communication)
implementation_examples: Document and maintain policies, processes, and procedures for transparency about data-processing purposes, practices, and associated privacy risks
Align transparency content with regulator expectations and with internal breach-reporting obligations
Version and publish notices (privacy notices, employee notices, processor notices) consistently
assessment_objectives: Determine whether transparency policies and processes are documented
Determine whether the policies cover purposes, practices, and associated risks
Determine whether notices are aligned with regulator expectations
Determine whether the policies are reviewed on a defined cadence
